changes: Added set_sigma_annual(double) and set_twap_so_far(double) test setters
Changed deterministic case from 0.99/0.01 to 1.0/0.0 (P=1.0 when TWAP > K)
Changed TWAP fallback from current_price to strike (Window open price=strike)
Fixed unused-parameter error on bankroll (now used in should_trade check)
Added tau clipping to max(0, tau)
Added equality handling for twap_so_far == strike_price (P=0.5)
Switched to time-weighted TWAP (price_sum_/tick_time_ instead of simple average)
Added edge case guards in on_price (out-of-order timestamps, bad data)
Added set_var_fast(double) and set_var_slow(double) test setters for regime verification
SHOCK regime (vol_fast > 2x vol_slow) cannot be triggered from returns alone with λ_fast=0.94, λ_slow=0.98 — max ratio is sqrt(3)≈1.73 < 2.0

files_created.description: Complete Brownian Bridge formula derivation, volatility conversion, fee/trade logic, and known-answer test values

integration_notes: TwapBrownianBridge::compute() returns ProbResult with p_up ∈ [0.01, 0.99] for probabilistic, [0.0, 0.5, 1.0] for deterministic. evaluate_trade() returns TradeDecision with should_trade, edge_after_fees, fee_cost, kelly_fraction. VolatilityEstimator provides effective_vol(), current_regime(), and regime_vol_multiplier() for sigma adjustment. Both headers are header-only with zero heap allocation.
